posts.name: Pavithra Rajindra
posts.cooked:
I had last taken the SCT in Jan 2025, and opted to use the same SCT result for the May term as well.
I read that the SCT result is valid for the current term and the next two terms. However on LookerStudio and the Student Dashboard, the status is displayed as “Approved”.
I want to clarify if this is a glitch or my SCT result is still valid for the Jan’26 term as well.
(PS: I had not taken any SCT-required courses in Sep’25 term, in case that is relevant)

posts.name: Gurkirat Singh
posts.cooked: I also gave in J25 term and it shows “Approved“ so it means approved.

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: Please mail support regarding a confirmation about this.

posts.name: Vikas
posts.cooked: i have the same issue and I mailed them. They replied back saying I should take the SCT test again by creating my own google meet. What do they mean by that ?

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: They probably meant that you can take your setup’s photos using your own Google Meet and then submit these on the SCT form. But just to be safe ask them for clarification too.
